observations: Three large, grey, cylindrical industrial machines with conical bases, mounted on metal frames.
Each machine has a rectangular access door with red Chinese characters written vertically on it.
The machines appear to be part of a feed mill system, with one machine in photo 2 connected to a smaller unit with a flexible hose and a blue motor.
The environment is a warehouse or workshop with concrete floors and walls, and some debris or sacks on the floor.
Watermarks 'GODWIN AGRICULTURE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are visible on all photos.
Photo 0 and 1 show multiple identical units side by side; photo 2 shows one unit with an attached smaller machine.
The red Chinese characters on the doors read '质量第一' (Quality First) and '信誉至上' (Reputation Supreme).

claims.claim: Our feed mill machine is imported (foreign made)
claims.evidence: No visible country of origin, brand, or model markings that confirm import status. The Chinese characters suggest Chinese origin, but this is not proof of import.

claims.claim: it's made with high quality steel
claims.evidence: The material appears to be painted metal, but there is no visible proof of steel grade or quality. No certification or markings to confirm.
The phrase is likely a typo or autocorrect error (possibly meant to be 'built to stand' or 'built to last'). Cannot verify intent or meaning from photos.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have hidden mechanical defects.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine operating, including the motor, conveyor, and discharge system in motion.

risks.risk: The machine may be damaged or corroded internally, especially in the conical base or hopper areas.
risks.proof: Close-up photos or video of the interior of the hopper and base, showing condition of the metal and any rust or wear.

risks.risk: The machine may not be suitable for the buyer's intended use or capacity, or may require additional components to operate.
risks.proof: Photos of the entire system, including power connections, control panel, and any missing parts.

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation, showing motor, conveyor, and discharge.
Close-up photos of the interior of the hopper and base to check for rust or damage.
Photos of the control panel, power connections, and any missing components.
Clear photo of any brand or model markings, if present.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a feed mill machine, but critical claims about origin, material quality, and functionality cannot be verified from the current photos. Hidden risks related to functionality and internal condition require additional proof before pricing can be determined.
